theorem.criterion: W_H is rootless iff theta_K(a,nu)=0 for every (a,nu) in F_(C,H).
theorem.enumeration_consequence: A bridge and graph prescribe a finite zero mask on the core before K is constructed; only those core theta cells need be queried for the rootless decision.
theorem.reason: Every convolution summand is a nonnegative integer, so a zero sum is equivalent to coefficientwise vanishing.
theorem.support_hypergraph: Rootlessness depends only on Boolean theta support. Modulo theta_K(a,nu)=theta_K(-a,nu), the bridge universe is a finite antichain of forbidden-support masks; a core is compatible iff its support avoids at least one mask.
